text:
Nikhil: quick note - sampled logs + redaction is making incident replay brittle. propose a tenant-scoped HMAC 'field-id' to join sampled traces without raw PII.
Ana: sounds useful. minimal API change?
Nikhil: add X-RI-FieldId in metadata and store small hex id next to redacted fields. deterministic, no stored mapping.
Rowan: replayable? ops often re-run requests.
Nikhil: default replay uses deterministic surrogate generator seeded by field-id; enterprise can request audited unredact via breakglass.
Ana: routing/quotas for live-debugging?
Rowan: add opt-in debug pool with header X-Debug-Mode and strict per-tenant caps. bill separately.
OpsBot: feature-flag created: "field-id-prototype" on eng-platform.
Ana: can we prototype middleware to HMAC sensitive fields and synth surrogates and bench perf?
Nikhil: yes, I'll do a tiny middleware PR + RFC and include perf + cost estimate.
Rowan: tagging privacy for review @legal-team.
Nikhil: RFC ticket will be posted when PR lands. end.
